## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 34. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke establishes two facts before anything else: yes, Sacramento State is an FBS team now, and yes, they are in the MAC. He then places the coach — Carter is a Brent Brennan disciple in some respects, though he was already coaching high school ball when Brennan was playing for UCLA, and he was on Brennan's staffs at both San Jose State and Arizona, most recently as assistant head coach and running backs coach. He notes the gap in the résumé: he hasn't been a head coach since 2016 at Contra Costa Junior College. His comparison is institutional — given the wild commitment to the basketball team with head coach Mike Bibby and GM Shaquille O'Neal, Carter, a one-time backup dancer for MC Hammer, seems like an odd hire by comparison. He closes on the counterweight: the Oakland native is said to be a great mentor and resource for students.
